policy: Only sites whose coordinates are supported by a primary source (mission/archive/imaging team). Coordinates are copied from the cited source; none are estimated. Candidate/proposed regions without published coordinates are listed under pending_regions and are NOT selectable sites.

sites.name: IM-1 Odysseus landing site (near Malapert A)
sites.reference_height_source: NAIF CLPS SPICE frame kernel clps_to2im_im1_v02.tf: altitude 0.2583E+01 km above the 1737.4 km sphere (LROC states 2579 m).
sites.notes: Touched down 2024-02-22 UTC about 1.5 km from the intended target; resting on a ~12 degree slope (LROC).

sources.label: NAIF CLPS SPICE archive: IM-1 frame kernel
sources.description: NASA/JPL NAIF PDS4 archive. Defines IM1_LANDING_SITE in frame MOON_ME on a 1737.4 km sphere.

sources.label: LROC (NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University) image page 1360
sources.description: LRO Camera team confirmation of the lander position from NAC imagery acquired 2024-02-24.
sources.quote: Odysseus came to rest at 80.13°S, 1.44°E, 2579 m elevation

sites.name: IM-2 Athena landing site (Mons Mouton)
sites.reference_height_source: NAIF CLPS SPICE frame kernel clps_prime1_im2_v01.tf: altitude 0.5321E+01 km above the 1737.4 km sphere.
sites.notes: Reached the surface 2025-03-06 and ended up on its side in a ~20 m diameter crater (LROC).

sources.label: NAIF CLPS SPICE archive: IM-2 frame kernel
sources.description: NASA/JPL NAIF PDS4 archive. Defines IM2_LANDING_SITE in frame MOON_ME on a 1737.4 km sphere.

sources.label: LROC (NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University) image page 1408
sources.description: LRO Camera team oblique image of the landed vehicle (NAC M1495922531LR), published 2025-03-10. Same LROC site as lroc.asu.edu, which redirects here.
sources.quote: ended up on its side within a 20-meter diameter crater ([84.7906° S, 29.1957° E]

sites.name: IM-2 intended landing site (pre-landing target)
sites.notes: Pre-landing TARGET published by LROC on 2025-02-26. Not where the lander came to rest; see im2-athena.

sources.label: LROC (NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University) image page 1401
sources.description: LROC 'IM-2 Landing Region', published 2025-02-26 by Mark Robinson, before touchdown.
sources.quote: The Intuitive Machines IM-2 intended landing site (-84.78°, 29.13°E) is 160 kilometers from the south pole

sites.name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram landing site (Statio Shiv Shakti)
sites.reference_height_source: LROC image page 1314 (532 m elevation; datum as stated by LROC, assumed to be the LOLA sphere-referenced height - unverified here).
sites.notes: Touched down 2023-08-23 (ISRO). About 600 km from the south pole, so it lies outside the 80S LOLA product; useful as an out-of-coverage test for the 20 m DEM.

sources.label: LROC (NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University) image page 1314
sources.description: LRO Camera team oblique image of the lander (NAC M1447750764LR), published 2023-09-05.
sources.quote: located about 600 kilometers from the south pole ([69.3741°S, 32.32°E, 532 m elevation]

pending_regions.name: NASA Artemis III candidate landing regions (nine, Oct 2024 update): Peak near Cabeus B, Haworth, Malapert Massif, Mons Mouton Plateau, Mons Mouton, Nobile Rim 1, Nobile Rim 2, de Gerlache Rim 2, Slater Plain
pending_regions.reason: Names and the ~15 km region size are published by NASA, but no authoritative centre coordinates were located in a primary source during Stage 2. Not included as selectable sites (decision C7).

pending_regions.name: Luna 25 impact site
pending_regions.reason: Not an intact landing and the LROC release was not located during Stage 2.
